\newlength{\dlboxwidth}
\newlength{\dlboxheight}
\newlength{\dlboxdepth}
\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%
  \ifdim\dlboxwidth=0pt

\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item \duallayerbox{Which muscle is the most active during a right lateral excursion of the mandible?}{Which muscle is the primary elevator of the mandible during right-sided clenching?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Left masseter muscle
    \item Right buccinator muscle
    \item Right temporalis muscle
    \item Right masseter muscle
    \item Right lateral pterygoid muscle
\end{enumerate}
\item If the frequency of males affected with an X-linked recessive condition in a human
population is .10 (one in ten), what will be the expected frequency of affected females?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 0.001
    \item 0.01
    \item 0.1
    \item 0.15
    \item 0.0011
\end{enumerate}
\item The proportion of babies that have an abnormality identifiable at birth is \_\_\_\_\_.
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 1 in 100
    \item 1 in 50
    \item 1 in 5
    \item 1 in 10
    \item 1 in 1000
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{How are antibody producing cells stimulated?}{How do cytotoxic T cells recognize and respond to virus infected cells?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Interacting with a virus short peptide
    \item Interacting with a T helper cell.
    \item Interacting with a plasma cell
    \item Interacting with a virus infected cell
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following is most strongly associated with loss of bone density?}{Which of the following is most strongly associated with inherited patterns of bone fragility?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Environmental factors such as exposure to radiation
    \item Genetic factors
    \item Psychological factors such as stress levels
    \item Atmospheric factors such as air pollution
    \item Socioeconomic factors such as income level
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}

\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]

\item True or False: \duallayerbox{The ureter is the primary structure responsible for collecting urine in the body before it reaches the bladder.}{The renal pelvis is the primary structure responsible for collecting urine from the kidneys before it enters the ureter.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{The risk of abnormality in the child of a mother with untreated phenylketonuria is approximately 25\textbackslash{}\%.}{The risk of abnormality in the child of a mother with untreated phenylketonuria is less than 1\textbackslash{}\%.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{The elderly often play a crucial role in facilitating effective change within a community due to their experience and influence.}{The elderly rarely have any meaningful impact on community decisions, regardless of their experience or influence.}
\item True or False: Research has shown that prenatal maternal stress is a significant factor in social epigenetics, influencing fetal development.
\end{enumerate}
